evidence: Touches RPC request parsing machinery in src/rpc/request.cpp and carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ maintainer label.
rationale: Fixes incorrect ID reuse and suppressed error responses when non-object elements appear in JSON-RPC batch requests. While important for JSON-RPC 2.0 spec compliance as noted by reviewers ('could confuse consumers of the interface expecting unique IDs in batch responses'), it addresses an edge case involving malformed batch inputs that is reasonably deferrable.
